subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should this be fixed narrowly in Telegram plain-group route persistence, by a shared non-direct delivery-context fallback, or by both with staged proof?
rationale: The visible Telegram source gap is narrow, but related Mattermost and shared-session reports show adjacent non-direct delivery-context failures where a shared fix could alter cross-channel session routing behavior.

options.title: Fix Telegram plain groups first
options.body: Add live Telegram plain-group restart proof and persist the Telegram group last route without broadening shared fallback behavior until cross-channel proof exists.

options.title: Adopt shared fallback
options.body: Refresh or replace the shared fallback PR after compatibility review for non-direct channel session routing.

options.title: Wait for live repro
options.body: Keep the issue blocked on current-main Telegram restart proof before choosing the implementation boundary.

recommendation.title: Fix Telegram plain groups first
recommendation.body: Add live Telegram plain-group restart proof and persist the Telegram group last route without broadening shared fallback behavior until cross-channel proof exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the shared inbound session recorder history tied to steipete and the Telegram-specific route boundary.
